items: 1 head iceberg lettuce, chopped or torn into bite-sized pieces
2 cups or approximately half of a 16 oz bag frozen peas, thawed
¼ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing
4 slices (4 oz) Swiss cheese, cubed or in strips

steps.title: Layer the salad
steps.body: Layer **1 head iceberg lettuce**, chopped or torn into bite-sized pieces, and **2 cups frozen peas** (or approximately half of a 16 oz bag), thawed.

steps.title: Add the dressing
steps.body: Top with dressing made with **¼ cup mayonnaise**, **¼ cup Miracle Whip salad dressing**, **1 tsp sugar**, **½ tsp salt** and **¼ tsp pepper**.

steps.title: Add the toppings
steps.body: Top with **4 strips bacon**, cooked and crumbled, **4 slices (4 oz) Swiss cheese**, cubed or in strips, and **3 green onions**.
